text:
maria_h: Heads-up — since the key rotation yesterday we're seeing intermittent 403s from a subset of EU tenants during SCIM provisioning. Affected clients all use the new OIDC client_id.
sam_t: Saw this in the SRE dashboard too. Error rate ~3-6% for /scim/v2/Users POSTs from eu-1.
kevin-kms: Can you paste the decrypt error from the service logs? I want to check KMS wrapping metadata.
maria_h: Pasted a snip from staging logs:```
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z ERROR scim: decrypt: envelope header mismatch: alg=RSA-OAEP vs expected RSA1_5
client_id=redwood-eu-tenant-42 subject=svc-123 status=403
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z WARN scim: fallback to non-encrypted payload for tenant redwood-eu-tenant-42
```
kevin-kms: OK that's interesting — our rewrap job used OAEP for new keys but the client libraries for some tenants still expect RSA1_5. That would explain the envelope header mismatch.
anya_oncall: @kevin-kms any quick mitigation? Can we accept both alg headers temporarily?
kevin-kms: We can change the KMS proxy to accept either alg for 48h, but we'd prefer to coordinate with client SDKs. Rolling that out now to the eu-proxy group.
sam_t: Also noticed RBAC delta — a config push yesterday added a stricter assertion audience check on the SCIM proxy. If the client_id differ (rotated id vs old) it returns 403. So two simultaneous changes (KMS rewrap + audience check) create a hit.
maria_h: Right — for some tenants the client_id rotated and the SDK didn't pick up the new envelope alg, so decrypt fails and then the audience check is applied to fallback token -> 403.
julian_research: From a vuln triage POV, any chance the fallback path could allow unsigned assertions? I quickly scanned the code: there is a fallback branch that treats un-decryptable payloads as opaque and validates only audience.
kevin-kms: That fallback does not accept unsigned assertions today, but it's a good callout — I'll add an assertion signature check there as a hard requirement.
anya_oncall: Plan: 1) Roll eu-kms-proxy to accept RSA1_5 + OAEP for 48h (kevin) 2) Back out the audience-tightening rule for 2 hours in eu cluster (sam) 3) Notify tenants to upgrade SDK to 1.4.2 which includes OAEP support (maria) 4) Add assertion signature enforcement on fallback (kevin) 5) Audit logs to capture which tenant used which alg and client_id (julian)
sam_t: I'll open a short rollback PR for the audience rule now and queue it for immediate deploy.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated: rollback-audience-rule (reviewed by sam_t) — job #4821 queued on eu cluster
maria_h: Maria to owners@tenants: sending brief email and posting to tenant status page with recommended SDK bump and expected 2hr window.
kevin-kms: eu-kms-proxy rolled (canary) — accepting RSA1_5 + OAEP in header parsing. Monitoring decrypt errors.
julian_research: I'll start a quick audit query: `select tenant, alg, count(*) from scim_decrypt where ts > now()-1d group by tenant, alg;` will share counts in 10m.
anya_oncall: After rollback deploy completes, we should see 403s drop to baseline. If not, escalate to network team.
maria_h: Thanks everyone. Action owners updated in the incident doc. I'll update thread when tenant comms are out. :white_check_mark:
sam_t: Rollback merged and deployed to eu cluster — 15:27 UTC. Watching errors.
julian_research: Audit results: tenant redwood-eu-tenant-42 had 420 decrypt failures, alg mostly `RSA1_5` attempts prior to rotation, then mixed. Sending CSV to infra.
kevin-kms: After proxy roll, decrypt failures dropped ~98% for those tenants. I've also opened a patch (PR#1234) to enforce signature validation in the fallback branch.
maria_h: Tenant comms posted. SDK upgrade adoption tracking started. Closing interim incident; we'll follow up with a postmortem once PR#1234 lands and we confirm no more fallbacks.
anya_oncall: Nice work. Follow-up items: add an integration test for envelope alg negotiation and add an audit alert for >50 decrypt failures in 1h.
maria_h: Noted — assigning to product-security backlog.
kevin-kms: Also filing a minor vuln ticket to track the fallback signature hardening (PS-452).
anya_oncall: If anything spikes, @anya_oncall will reopen. Good job team :rocket:
